data.summary: Fund operations professional with 8+ years in investment banking, managing private equity, private credit, real estate, hedge, and debt funds. Specializes in fund valuations, capital account tracking, and investor reporting, with a background in portfolio reconciliation and portfolio management support. Skilled in processing capital calls, distributions, and NAV, with a strong track record of accurate, deadline-driven reporting and client relationship management.

◗ Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Estate, Hedge & Debt Fund Operations • Fund Valuations & Capital Accounts ◗ Fund Accounting • Cash Flow Analysis • Investment Banking ◗ Financial Reporting • Portfolio Reconciliation • Asset Management • Accounting • Corporate Actions ◗ Trade Settlements • Accounts Payable • Invoice Processing • Wire Transfers & Cash Management

◗ Microsoft Excel (Advanced) • Microsoft Word • Microsoft PowerPoint • AI Copilot Tools ◗ Fund Operations Platforms: Efront • Portfolio Center
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Associate | State Street Global Advisors India Pvt Ltd Bangalore, Karnataka
07/2020 – 05/2026
◗ Tracked quarterly fund valuations from capital accounts and rolled forward valuations using cash flow notices,
ensuring accurate, up-to-date fund performance data across various asset classes.
◗ Performed trade capture and validation of investment transactions by recording capital calls, distributions,
subscriptions, and fund movements, ensuring accurate transaction booking, reconciliation, and downstream NAV reporting
◗ Tracked original commitments and unfunded obligations using cash flow notices and capital accounts, supporting
accurate capital planning for private equity and real estate funds.
◗ Processed capital calls, distributions, and valuations to capture fund investment cost, realized/unrealized value, and
gross/net multiples within Efront, ensuring accurate financial reporting.
◗ Supported preparation of monthly/quarterly investor reports covering fund and portfolio company performance,
including NAV and capital account activity.
◗ Executed wire transfers and fund movements under strict compliance controls, safeguarding accuracy. ◗ Monitored custody cash positions daily to protect liquidity, flagging and resolving discrepancies before they impacted
operational efficiency.
◗ Identified and implemented process improvements to fund reconciliation and reporting workflows, increasing team
productivity and reducing turnaround time.
◗ Reviewed TPD occupancy variances against NOI analysis to identify discrepancies, supporting data-driven decision-
making for real estate fund performance.
◗ Delivered TIC SLT regulatory reports for RE and IPE funds to the compliance/regulatory team, meeting all submission
deadlines.
◗ Coordinated invoice processing and purchase order generation with the Accounts Payable team, synchronizing
reporting to eliminate reconciliation gaps.
◗ Responded to tax audit requests by preparing and submitting required documentation within specified timelines,
supporting a clean audit trail.
Operations Analyst | Envestnet Asset Management India Pvt Ltd Trivandrum, Kerala
05/2016 – 12/2019
◗ Processed and analyzed client trading activity on the Envestnet platform, identifying and correcting performance
discrepancies to maintain data accuracy.
◗ Verified quarterly performance reports for client accounts, ensuring accuracy prior to client delivery. ◗ Performed portfolio center reconciliation and dedicated portfolio management support for an assigned client book,
maintaining data integrity across reporting cycles.
◗ Utilized multiple custodian platforms to perform account-level reconciliation, ensuring accuracy of holdings and cash
positions across client accounts.
◗ Posted daily security pricing for client portfolios via the Portfolio Center platform and processed corporate actions,
reconciling accounts to ensure accuracy.
◗ Resolved client service tickets, including requests received outside standard SLA windows, maintaining service quality
and client satisfaction under time pressure.
◗ Partnered directly with a US-based servicing team to deliver responsive, high-quality client service and support ad hoc
project requests within deadline.
